intent: Build one local_gbp_conversion priority-growth improvement for haveo in the isolated worktree

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Reprioritize the existing homepage download action without changing the brand, guide layouts, destinations, or runtime.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: La acción principal debe ser obvia, cómoda para el pulgar y decir lo que pasa al tocar.
visual_evidence.comparison: Baseline has three similarly prominent buttons. Candidate has one download button, compact supporting links, and clear device context before the button.

references.borrow: Haveo blue, cream, Quicksand, mascot and direct attributed App Store anchor.
references.avoid: Equal emphasis on social, feedback and download; decorative shapes across text.

brief.visitor: A visitor searching for Haveo who wants to prepare for a networking event.
brief.promise: Identify the iPhone and iPad app and make downloading the obvious first action.
brief.primary_action: Open the existing App Store listing with pt=128642904 and ct=site-hero.
brief.friction: Three large competing hero buttons and device context below all three. This is a layout hypothesis, not proven conversion causation.

kpi.outcome: App Store installs attributable to the site.
kpi.event: app_store_click, placement site-hero, is an intermediate signal.
kpi.denominator: Human homepage visits for click rate; Apple campaign viewers for installs.
kpi.baseline: Conversion/install rate unavailable in this bounded call; do not infer zero from Search Console.
kpi.evidence: binding.json binds the supplied immutable Search Console action brief and current Apple listing lookup.
kpi.readout: cto-growth-lead compares seven days before versus seven days after the adapter records deployment.
kpi.decision_rule: Keep if comparable qualified traffic does not show a decline; low volume remains inconclusive.

concept.idea: One familiar blue download button with compact social and feedback links below.
concept.brand_reason: Reuse Haveo existing mascot, typeface, blue, cream and rounded button.
concept.interaction: Tap download or use the keyboard; optionally follow or share feedback.
concept.visible_response: Existing button feedback and native external navigation; feedback anchor opens the relevant section.
concept.direct_path: The original attributed App Store href remains directly available without JavaScript.
concept.alternatives: Retain current three-button row as rollback; no new sticky bar, modal or install funnel.

story.opening: Explain that Haveo is an iPhone and iPad app for networking event prep.
story.consequence: App Store listing opens where the user can choose to install.
story.next_step: Optional social and feedback paths remain secondary.

content.visible: Offer, platform, free availability, direct store button, privacy note and supporting links.
content.optional_html: Existing native FAQ details unchanged and present in raw HTML.
content.linked_depth: Existing guide network unchanged; no new thin local page.

references.borrow: Existing Haveo composition, canonical taste rules for clear primary and compact secondary actions.
references.avoid: Generic template styling, equal weight on three buttons, invented local/GBP facts.

components.reuse: Existing static native anchors and brand button; RailCta/RailFaq manifests and REVIEW.md inspected.
components.local_reason: Small static HTML repair; React component runtime is unnecessary. Homepage-only second style block avoids guide CSS changes.

verification.rendered_states: Chromium/WebKit at 375x667, 390x844, 390x600 and 1280x800; see verification.json and PNGs.
verification.motion: Reduced-motion state checked; no new scene motion. New pressed offset has a reduced-motion override.
verification.accessibility_performance: Header axe checks, keyboard focus, touch activation, no overflow; no extra network runtime. Whole-page gate remains AMBER with unchanged contrast/small-text findings.
verification.raw_html: Device explanation, attributed download link and updated date present without JavaScript; 93 site pages pass page contract.
verification.conversion_boundary: Chromium opens the Apple listing; live HTTP destination preserves pt/ct. WebKit records unprevented touch/keyboard activation but its native Apple handoff remains unverified.

reviewers.craft: Top-level coordinator dispatches Antigravity independently before release; not invoked by this bounded builder.
reviewers.behavior: cto-qa-lead with Claude fidelity verification before release; native iPhone handoff still needs confirmation.
reviewers.outcome: cto-growth-lead at deployment plus seven days; no uplift claimed.
